evidence: Design is graded, not all-or-nothing: tests/scoring.toml:1-11 (template-identical) puts two zero-weight all_pass gates in front of functional 0.6 / polish 0.2 / visual 0.2 with a functional floor of 0.05; score.py:46-48 returns the weighted mean when gates and floor pass. Functional has 43 independent binary criteria with weights 1.0-2.0 (total 59.0) spanning editor, find/replace, format, run sandbox, persistence and live sync, so one criterion moves the reward by 0.6*1/59 ~ 0.010; polish has 6 binaries; visual has 3 five-point likerts with anchors. The gates are narrow and publicly required (ui.md:3 custom editor; behaviour.md:9 / integration.md:9 server-side SQLite persistence) and do not depend on most scored behaviours, and the functional criteria do not share one precondition beyond typing, which the constraints gate already requires to pass. Measured spread exists only on v15 (task_checksum 8b9c23ff..., hashes re-verified): oracle 1.0, nop 0.0 (no_op=1), GPT-5.6-luna 0.5746 with functional 0.4576 (27.0/59 weight passed, failures and passes interleaved across editor, run and persistence groups), polish 1.0, visual 0.5 (0.0/0.75/0.75). Comparing those reward-details with the v16 judge.toml files shows identical criterion ids and weights in all five dimensions, with descriptions unchanged except 7 functional criteria (cw_output_before_failure_kept, cw_last_good_recovery, cw_stop_cancels_pending_work, cw_newer_run_supersedes, cw_preview_isolation, cw_save_reload_restart, cw_history_restore_adds_revision; 10.5/59 weight). Reasoned bound: if the v15 GPT app flipped on every changed criterion, its v16 reward would still fall between about 0.50 and 0.62, so graded discrimination should survive. RISK: there is no configured-judge or mutated-weak-app reward-discrimination run on these v16 bytes (raw-evidence-index scope says so explicitly), and the scripted golden only checks the top end. The policy's hash-bound reward-discrimination record is therefore missing for this candidate, so the spread is inferred, not measured.
counterexample: Weak app tried: passes both gates (custom div editor, server-backed save), but only 2 of the 43 functional criteria pass (e.g. basic run + console levels = 2.0/59 = 0.034 <= 0.05 floor). Its excellent polish and visual craft then earns 0, the same as a blank page. This is the intended template floor, not a task defect. Conforming alternative tried: an app using a CodeMirror-like editor or localStorage-only saves would score 0 via the gates, but both exclusions are explicit public requirements (ui.md:3, behaviour.md:9), so this is not lost signal. No credible collapse found; the only open item is missing v16 measurement.
suggested_fix: No task edit needed for this row. Before clearance, record a hash-bound reward-discrimination run on the v16 bytes (configured judge on the golden plus at least one partial or mutated app, and a nop), or rerun hosted Oracle/nop/model on v16, and cite it in raw-evidence-index.json.
